dedupe_keys.name: pscad emtdc electromagnetic transient emt power system simulation software

description: PSCAD, which runs its simulations with EMTDC, is electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulation software for power systems from Manitoba Hydro International Ltd., which calls it the most popular power system transient simulation package and notes more than 40 years of development. Users build and simulate systems from a library of models ranging from passive elements and control functions to electric machines and other complex devices. The version comparison for v4.6, v5.0 and v5.1 lists, among others, an MMC model library, IEEE 421.5-2016 exciter models, a co-simulation interface, parallel multiple runs, a cluster launch system, embedded Python scripting and MATLAB support. Coverage: generic software; the company also sells engineering studies on HVDC and FACTS, renewable energy integration and electromagnetic transients. Format and access: desktop software licensed through certificates from a cloud licensing manager; a free edition, fully featured but limited in network size, can be downloaded with a MyCentre account; example cases, a knowledge base and courses are offered. Licence: proprietary; full edition prices were not read. Caveats: the free edition's network size limit was not read, and neither were the brochure and example cases. Simulation uses: detailed transient studies of faults, converters and protection in electricity networks. Related records: DIgSILENT PowerFactory (platform-digsilent-powerfactory) covers similar studies, and GE Vernova PSLF (platform-ge-vernova-pslf-power-flow-software) covers planning-level load flow.
